content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments for digital products are a decentralized alternative to traditional payment gateways. By leveraging Solana’s low-cost, high-speed blockchain, creators can accept payments in cryptocurrencies like USDT or SOL directly from buyers. This system eliminates reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, which often reject creators in certain regions or charge exorbitant fees. For example, Gumroad takes 10% per sale, while NOWPayments charges just 0.5%. At 100 sales per month of a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. This isn’t a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure that gives creators full control over their commerce stack.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of four core components: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages (free). Backend logic is managed via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free), which automates order fulfillment. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets (free), and file delivery is executed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). NOWPayments integrates with Solana to verify on-chain payments and trigger instant product delivery. The system is designed to be modular, so creators can swap components as needed without disrupting operations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, and you’ve been locked out of Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to retain more revenue by avoiding platform fees. By owning your infrastructure, you eliminate dependency on third parties. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent solution that scales with your business, tested in environments like Zimbabwe where currency collapse and financial isolation are realities.
Solana payments retain 99.5% of revenue compared to Gumroad’s 90%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component serves a specific function. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront at zero cost. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend tasks like order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, converting USD prices to Solana or other cryptocurrencies at transaction time. The system is designed to be lightweight yet robust, ensuring that even creators with limited technical expertise can deploy and maintain it. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access—you own and control everything.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting and backend tools. GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script are ideal for beginners, while Cloudflare Pages and Workers offer more advanced features. Set up NOWPayments to accept Solana payments, and configure your order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. Load your products into the system, test end-to-end functionality, and launch. For a step-by-step guide, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything you need to build and scale your sovereign commerce stack. Instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using Solana payments via NOWPayments. Host your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. NOWPayments verifies Solana transactions and triggers instant file delivery. This eliminates platform fees and geographic restrictions, giving you full control over your sales process.
This stack is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe—where it works when nothing else does.

Instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re in Nigeria, the Philippines, or Venezuela, this infrastructure is designed to work where traditional platforms fail.
Your Deployment Checklist

Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. Integrate NOWPayments for Solana payment processing. Load your digital products into the system. Test end-to-end functionality to ensure seamless delivery. Deploy your storefront and start accepting payments. For a complete guide, download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The stack is designed to be accessible, with options like Google Apps Script and Google Sheets that require minimal technical knowledge. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates and blueprints to guide you through deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Solana (SOL), USDT, Bitcoin, and Ethereum. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay recurring fees for this infrastructure?
No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and Supabase. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% charge per transaction. There are no subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The architecture is modular and scalable. You can upgrade components like switching from Google Sheets to Supabase or adding more products without disrupting operations. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook.
What happens if Solana transactions fail?

NOWPayments automatically retries transaction verification until confirmed on-chain. If a payment fails, the buyer is notified to retry. The system ensures that only verified payments trigger product delivery.
You own the infrastructure. No platform can shut you down or change the rules.
